description: Post the result of a job a user handed off to you (find hand-offs with list_tasks handoff=true; read the brief and its context with get_task). Give a one-line summary that continues your name, e.g. 'found 3 suppliers that can ship by Oct 12', and the results: supplier options (name, location, moq, unitPrice, currency, shipBy, url, notes) and findings (title, detail). The result is posted under this connection's name, the hand-off is completed, and a user who asked by text is texted the summary. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

results.description: What you found: supplier options and findings (at most 20).

currency.description: supplier_option: ISO currency code of unitPrice, e.g. USD.

location.description: supplier_option: where they are, e.g. city and country.

moq.description: supplier_option: minimum order quantity, in the item's units.

notes.description: supplier_option: anything else worth knowing (lead time, terms, caveats).

shipBy.description: supplier_option: the date they can ship by, YYYY-MM-DD.

type.description: supplier_option for a supplier that could fill the need, finding for anything else.

summary.description: One line that continues your name in a text to the user, e.g. 'found 3 suppliers that can ship by Oct 12' (max 300 characters, no links).

taskId.description: The hand-off's task id (GUID) from list_tasks handoff=true.

name: complete_handoff
title: Complete Hand-off
